_meta.notes: Worked example of a finished HANDOFF.json (kind: writing). Every verbatim value occurs literally in the thread it came from.

title: Fieldnote launch email sequence
objective: Ship a 3-email launch sequence for Fieldnote (a note-taking app) to freelance designers, in a professional tone, and get it to the agency contact for scheduling before the deadline.
current_state: All three emails and the unsubscribe footer are drafted and merged into one HTML file for the email platform. The email 1 subject line is fixed and approved. Audience: freelance designers. Outline: announcement, proof, last call; all three sections are drafted and none is signed off beyond the subject line. Legal has not yet approved the footer wording, so the merged file is a draft.

decisions.why: The first draft read as too playful for freelance designers and the user rejected it.

decisions.what: Three-email arc: announcement, proof, last call
decisions.why: The user approved this structure; each email stays under 150 words.

decisions.what: No A/B test on the subject line
decisions.why: The user judged it too complicated for this launch.
The email platform takes a single upload, and it replaces the three separate drafts.

dead_ends.why: Email clients strip animated GIFs, so the timer never renders. Not fixable on the client side.
The user said no pressure tactics, so it was removed.

artifacts.name: sequence.html
artifacts.status: draft: merged file, waiting on legal approval of the footer

artifacts.name: footer.md
artifacts.status: draft: wording not yet approved by legal

verbatim.label: Upload error seen with the HTML version

preferences: Professional tone: no jokes or slang.
Never use exclamation marks; keep every email under 150 words.
No pressure tactics: no urgency, countdowns or scarcity.
Keep the approved subject line and button text word for word.

open_items.next: Send sequence.html to Dana at dana@agency.example once legal approves the footer wording.
then: Ask Dana to confirm both send dates are scheduled.

blocked.unblocks: Legal approval of the footer wording

unresolved: Plain text or HTML: the question was asked and never answered.
The send date for email 3 was never set.
uncertain: Legal was mentioned once with no timeline; whether they will change the footer wording is unconfirmed.
